name: Achish
bio: Achish son of Maachah was king of Gath in Solomon's time — a later ruler bearing the same name and title as the Achish who had once sheltered David generations earlier. When two of Shimei's runaway servants fled to him, Shimei went to Gath to retrieve them, breaking the oath Solomon had bound him with never to leave Jerusalem, and was executed as a result (1 Kings 2:39-41).
